This plot is for my beans, and beans do not need much chemical fertilizer because they bring their own goodness from the air into the soil. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens before planting, and I keep my own seeds from last year's harvest like my mother taught me. The biggest trouble with beans here is the insects that eat the flowers and pods, so I must buy some pesticide and spray, otherwise I will harvest nothing. My children and I will do most of the work, but at weeding time and harvest I will call two or three people from the village to help me for a few days.
